scope: Newly authored CC0 engineering qualification of a fixed pretrained reader on supplied excerpts only; all benchmark TRAIN/DEV/calibration/confirmation roles empty.
candidate_intent: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B original pretrained checkpoint; immutable exact revision/assets/source code/license and next-token valid-label mapping required before admission. Unknown training/pretraining overlap retained; no impossible global corpus ID completeness requirement.

candidate_controls.forwards: Exactly six cases times three arms =18 fixed reader forwards; no generation, thinking, fine-tuning, calibration, label-order/prompt/model selection, retry or corpus benchmark.
candidate_controls.probabilities: Float64 stable softmax restricted to the three frozen single token label logits A/B/C. These are conditional label-token probabilities, not full-vocabulary probabilities or calibrated benchmark confidences.
candidate_controls.numeric_guard: Finite exact source literal number/year-candidate/currency/scale/percent/period lexemes and char/UTF8 provenance; explicit source unit/period ambiguity markers only. No arithmetic or conversion. Guard decision always null, raw probabilities unchanged; any structural_unknown refuses final main decision and fails required readiness.
candidate_controls.retrieval: One entire supplied source unit, fixed top_k1 in actual_native/lexical/positional, identical untruncated packing policy.

fixture_control.source: Independent newly authored fictional CC0 source excerpts; no epoch24 case reuse, old smoke reuse or benchmark text.
fixture_control.disclosure: Candidate worker/prompt/retrieval/guard frozen and hashes held before independent author discloses fixture inputs. Gold is sealed independently and excluded from candidate payload.
fixture_control.selection: One fixed authored bank, no case replacements or threshold/prompt changes after outputs.
fixture_control.source_semantics: E/C/N refers solely to the complete supplied fictional source excerpt for each case. Genuine omitted facts may be N; ambiguity in units/periods must never be repackaged as N.
fixture_control.negative_guard_cases: No new negative source-guard executions. Core numeric spans checked independently against manual gold; four existing implementation smoke guards checked from saved raw only.
fixture_control.six_extra_source_only_guards: Private sealed and UNEXECUTED; excluded from epoch25 qualification and publication. Existing four worker-owned exposed smoke guards alone are replayed from saved raw; no candidate import or extra evidence.py call.

seal_order: Admit exact immutable model source/license/weight metadata and finite candidate input/output/guard/retrieval contract.
Hold exact candidate implementation, prompt and valid-label map hashes before fixture disclosure.
Independent author freezes six inputs, manual source labels, exact supporting/contradicting/absence rationales, source span offsets and this acceptance protocol.
Publish or hold immutable sourcefreeze binding all candidate and audit input/scorer/gold/protocol hashes before actual native work; maintain gold logical separation.
Root verifies owned guardian and complete runtime closure, consumes one predeclared CPU-bounded engineering attempt, and executes once.
Seal original outputs, exact contexts/spans/token IDs/logits/probabilities and resources; verify process cleanup before independent postprediction manual-gold join.
Apply every frozen gate; record rejection explicitly and close unused slots without tuning. All six cases become exposed engineering DEV forever.

audit_activity_before_freeze.oracle_validation: Compile syntax only; no performance input/output consumed.

acceptance.proper_scores_vs_each_control: multiclass Brier and NLL must each nonincrease; fixed numerical comparison tolerance1e-12
acceptance.probability_contract: All18 rows exactly three finite probabilities in[0,1], sum within1e-8 of1, stable softmax replay from recorded frozen-token logits; fixed argmax ties favor A then B then C.

metrics.Brier: Mean over6 cases of sum over3classes (p_k-1[y=k])^2; no binary aggregation.
metrics.NLL: Mean over6 cases of -log(max(p_gold,1e-12)); probabilities themselves never clipped or rewritten.
metrics.comparison_scope: Matched authored engineering decisions, not a semantic benchmark or generalization claim.

acceptance.source_and_context: All18 whole-source contexts nonempty, exact source IDs/source char+UTF8 spans, manual numeric-literal provenance, fixed top1 packing and<=512 rendered prompt tokens; no candidate payload labels. Independent pure-string Qwen no-thinking prompt-hash reconstruction; no extra tokenizer/model call.
acceptance.source_guard: No unexpected refusal on the six unambiguous core cases; refusal remains rejection, not a dropped row. Global insufficiency unknown regardless of outcome.
acceptance.runtime: One owned engineering batch,CPUaffinity[0,1],≤600wallseconds including initialization,18readerforwards,cleanup and owned process closure; zero paid/GPU/training/calibration/benchmark/confirmation calls.

publication_scope: Only this protocol, scorer seal and core input payload are public before the run. Manual gold and oracle source remain independently held outside project, bound by exact SHA256; no unused future guard fixtures or private author script copied.
